name: Vedrixa Forms – User Registration Form, Signup Form & Drag & Drop Form Builder
author: registrationformbuilder

sections.description:
Create powerful user registration forms, signup forms, and contact forms in WordPress without writing any code.

Vedrixa Forms is a fast and lightweight drag and drop form builder plugin for WordPress designed for frontend user registration, signup forms, and lead generation.

Build complete user registration systems in WordPress — without using multiple plugins.

A powerful alternative to Contact Form 7 and WPForms, especially for user registration and signup workflows.

Easily create:
– User registration forms
– Signup forms
– Contact forms
– Membership forms
– Lead generation forms

—all from a single plugin.

🚀 Why Choose Vedrixa Forms?

Most form builders focus only on contact forms.

Vedrixa Forms is built specifically for user registration workflows, making it ideal for:

✔ Frontend user signup systems
✔ Membership websites
✔ Community platforms
✔ LMS & course websites
✔ Business lead generation

👉 No need for separate plugins for forms + registration.

Everything works in one place.

💡 Key Benefits

✔ Create frontend user registration forms easily
✔ Replace multiple plugins with one solution
✔ Improve user onboarding experience
✔ Capture leads and grow your audience
✔ Build scalable membership systems

Vedrixa Forms is perfect for creating user registration forms, signup forms, contact forms, membership forms, and lead generation forms in WordPress.

⚡ Drag & Drop Form Builder

Create forms visually inside WordPress using an intuitive builder.

  • No coding required
  • Real-time preview
  • Fast form creation
  • Works with any WordPress theme including Astra, Neve, and GeneratePress
  • Shortcode-based embedding

🔥 Core Features

  • Drag-and-drop WordPress form builder
  • Frontend user registration forms
  • Contact form builder
  • Email notifications & autoresponders
  • Google reCAPTCHA spam protection
  • Submission management dashboard
  • Role assignment during registration
  • Account activation & email verification
  • Password validation rules
  • AJAX-powered form submission
  • Shortcode support

🧠 Built for Registration Workflows

Vedrixa Forms goes beyond basic form plugins.

You can:

  • Create frontend user registration forms
  • Assign user roles automatically
  • Control account approval workflows
  • Collect custom profile data
  • Build membership-ready signup flows

📋 Available Form Fields

Basic Fields:
Text, Email, Number, Date, Textarea

Selection Fields:
Dropdown, Radio Buttons, Checkboxes

User Fields:
Username, Email, Password, Confirm Password
First Name, Last Name

Advanced Fields:
Country, Phone, Gender, Language, Website, Bio

Social Fields:
Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube

📊 Submission Management

Manage all form entries directly from your dashboard.

  • View and manage submissions
  • Track user registrations and leads
  • Filter and organize entries
  • Export-ready structure (Pro)

📢 Email Notifications

Stay updated with real-time alerts.

  • Admin notifications
  • User autoresponders
  • SMTP compatible

🛡️ Spam Protection

Protect your forms with built-in Google reCAPTCHA integration.

⚙️ Performance & Developer Friendly

  • Lightweight and optimized for speed
  • Built with WordPress coding standards
  • Secure data handling (sanitization & escaping)
  • AJAX-powered submissions
  • Developer-friendly structure

Designed with WordPress best practices for security, performance, and scalability.

Perfect for startups, agencies, and growing businesses.

sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via Plugins menu
  3. Open Vedrixa Forms
  4. Create your form
  5. Add shortcode to page
sections.faq:
Can I create frontend user registration forms in WordPress?

Yes, Vedrixa Forms supports full frontend user registration with role assignment.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No, everything works with drag-and-drop.

Can I create contact forms?

Yes, you can create both contact and registration forms.

Does it store submissions?

Yes, all entries are saved in your dashboard.

Does it support spam protection?

Yes, Google reCAPTCHA is supported.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, core features are free with optional Pro upgrade.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all standard WordPress themes.

Is Vedrixa Forms better than Contact Form 7 for registration forms?

Yes, Vedrixa Forms is specifically designed for user registration workflows, while Contact Form 7 focuses mainly on basic contact forms.
